title: simnibs-analyze
description: Modular pipeline for SimNIBS e-field analysis: NIfTI volume preprocessing, intra/extra-ROI feature extraction, inter/intra-subject analysis and visualisation. Designed for non-invasive brain stimulation studies (TMS/tDCS) with MNI registration via ANTsPy.
